subject: Pilot budget corridor + procurement gating — follow-up
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Torres <alex.torres@cloudmatrix.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Jul 2028 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot budget corridor + procurement gating — follow-up

Alex — thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap and two asks so we can lock a pilot proposal: 

Call notes (high level):
- Surface: search/assist feature heavy on short completions + some long-form summarization.
- Expected steady-state traffic (est.): 30–60M tokens/month in Q4 with upside to ~120M within 3–6 months if early metrics look good.
- Primary constraint: procurement requires PO for monthly spend > $25k and standard legal SLA asks (data retention + SOC2).

Pricing/unit economics we discussed (attached detailed sheet):
- Pilot (no commit, short-term): $11 / 1M tokens (estimated TXN quantization, KV cache enabled)
- 3–6 month commit band (recommended): $7–9 / 1M tokens depending on commit size and model variant
- Autoscaling burst pricing and dedicated pool options available for predictable latency (we can include in SOW)

Two asks:
1) Can you confirm the monthly budget corridor you have authority for today (dollars) and whether the $25k PO threshold is a hard gate or negotiable?
2) Who on your procurement/legal side should we include for an initial SOW/PO timeline call?

Next steps I propose:
- I’ll send a one-page pilot SOW and a price-breakdown PDF (attached).
- If the PO threshold is >$25k we’ll route to our channel for an accelerated contract path; otherwise we can do standard SOW + invoice.

If helpful, we can pencil a 30-minute procurement sync next Tue/Wed.

Thanks — looking forward.

Priyom Das
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
pri yom.das@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments (stubs): redwood_pricing_1M_tokens_breakdown.pdf, pilot-proposal-CloudMatrix-SOW.docx

From: Alex Torres <alex.torres@cloudmatrix.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Jul 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot budget corridor + procurement gating — follow-up

Priyom — thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Budget corridor: Finance carved out a Q4 pilot bucket of roughly $20k–$60k/month to start. That maps to approximately ~30–90M tokens/month at the rates you proposed (ballpark). We can stretch to $80k/mo if early signal warrants.
2) PO threshold: Our procurement requires a formal PO for any vendor invoices > $25k/month. That’s a firm policy for our AP team; we can, however, accelerate approvals for pilots that are categorised as strategic.
3) Procurement contact: Lisa Cheng (cc’d) handles vendor onboarding and PO issuance. Lisa — can you confirm typical lead time and whether you require a signed SOW before issuing the PO?

Two asks back: can you confirm the committed pricing tiers if we sign a 3-month minimum with a monthly floor (e.g., 60M tokens/month)? Also need clarity on SLA/uptime and data separation language for our security team.

Would prefer a procurement + legal call early next week — Tue 10–11 PT works for Lisa and me.

—Alex
Product Ops Manager | CloudMatrix Inc
alex.torres@cloudmatrix.com

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Jul 2028 10:00:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Pilot budget corridor + procurement gating — internal note

Priyom / Marissa — internal recommendation based on Alex’s numbers:

- If they seat at 30–60M tokens/month initially, offer a pilot package: 60-day pilot capped at 75M tokens/month priced at $9 / 1M tokens with a true-up if usage exceeds the cap. This keeps list pilot price a notch below no-commit rate and buys runway to prove ROI.
- Commit options: 3-month commitment at a 10% discount off the $9 pilot rate (so ~ $8.10 / 1M) if they sign a minimum 60M/month floor. For 6+ months, push to $7 / 1M depending on model selection.
- PO handling: if they can’t start with a $25k PO we can route through our pilot credit program for month one and invoice month two; otherwise require PO for month 1 invoice if > $25k.

Technical notes for SOW: include KV cache enablement + prefix cache assumptions and an SLO note for 95th pctl latency targets. I’ll attach a short SOW snippet for legal.

Neha
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Torres <alex.torres@cloudmatrix.com>, Lisa Cheng <lisa.cheng@cloudmatrix.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Jul 2028 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot budget corridor + procurement gating — follow-up

Alex / Lisa — thanks for the quick reply and for looping Lisa in. Appreciate the clarity on the PO gate. Summary and next steps below: 

Summary (agreed so far):
- CloudMatrix pilot budget corridor: $20k–$60k/month (will scale if metrics look good).
- Procurement: formal PO required for invoices > $25k/month (firm).
- Estimated token volumes: 30–90M tokens/month initial, with upside to 120M in a later phase.

Proposed commercial path (we can finalize on the Tue procurement call):
1) 60-day pilot (cap 75M tokens/mo): $9 / 1M tokens, month-to-month billing; we can credit the pilot month if you provide a PO>=$25k by invoice 2 (this is our standard pilot credit route).
2) If you convert to a 3-month commit at a 60M/mo floor: provisional rate $8.10 / 1M tokens (10% off pilot rate). 6+ month commits move to $7 / 1M depending on model variant.
3) SOW: Neha will include KV cache assumptions + 95th pctl latency SLO language. Legal / procurement: we’ll bring a lightweight SOW to the Tue call and aim for a PO issuance timeline (Lisa indicated ~3–4 weeks).

Next steps:
- Tue 10am PT procurement + legal sync (we’ll send calendar invite).
- I’ve attached the one-page pricing breakdown + a draft SOW for your review.
- Please confirm whether we should route invoices via PO number once issued or start with a net-30 invoice while PO is processed.

If you’re good with the above I’ll lock the calendar invite and loop our contracts lead for an accelerated execution path.

Thanks — talk Tuesday.

Priyom Das
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments (stubs): redwood_pricing_1M_tokens_breakdown.pdf, pilot-proposal-CloudMatrix-SOW.docx
